subject: eirwen
q: CLOSED BY EVIDENCE — 06-091. She is a survivor.
detail: Listed among Banshee Haven's survivors in one pass — explicitly from memory — and among Banshee Haven's citizens in the next. Two authored statements in direct opposition. A flight number settled it without anyone having to choose: 06-091, Porcelain Dolls. And Remielle, who was on neither list, holds 06-089 — two numbers away.
